DECLARE
 t_addr_id addresses.address_id%type;
 
BEGIN
 IF :locations.s_sponsor_id is not null and :system.record_status = 'INSERT' THEN
 DECLARE
 add_id varchar2(15);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 BEGIN
 SELECT address_id 
 INTO add_id
 FROM sponsors
 WHERE sponsor_id = :locations.s_sponsor_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; -- IM# 4878
 
 -- Added "intl_addr_flag" to the below SQL statement
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2011 for changes relating to adding international address columns
 t_addr_id := add_id;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 SELECT address_1, street_name, suite_apt, 
 zip4, mapsco,
 d_area_code, d_phone_no, extension,
 f_area_code, f_phone_no, E_mail,
 web_address, usps_id, intl_addr_flag
 INTO :addresses.address_1, :addresses.street_name, :addresses.suite_apt, 
 :addresses.zip4, :addresses.mapsco, 
 :addresses.d_area_code, :addresses.d_phone_no, :addresses.extension,
 :addresses.f_area_code, :addresses.f_phone_no, :addresses.E_mail,
 :addresses.web_address, :addresses.usps_id, :addresses.intl_addr_flag
 FROM addresses
 WHERE address_id = add_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- IM# 4878
 AND eff_date <= v_local_date; 

 if nvl(:addresses.intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'N' then -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2011 for changes relating to adding international address columns
 SELECT city, state, county,
 zip 
 INTO :addresses.city, :addresses.state, :addresses.county,
 :addresses.zip
 FROM valid_city_state 
 WHERE usps_id = :addresses.usps_id;
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2011 for changes relating to adding international address columns
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2011 for changes relating to adding international address columns
 :global.intl_addr_flag := :addresses.intl_addr_flag;
 
 if nvl(:global.intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y' then 
 :global.intl_street_name := :addresses.street_name;
 :global.intl_addr1 := :addresses.address_1;
 :global.intl_email := :addresses.e_mail;
 
 begin
 select country_name, intl_postal_code, intl_home_phone_no,
 intl_work_phone_no, intl_work_phone_ext,
 intl_mobile_phone_no, intl_fax_no, 
 address_2, address_3
 into :global.intl_country, :global.intl_postal_code, :global.intl_home_phone_no,
 :global.intl_work_phone_no, :global.intl_work_phone_ext,
 :global.intl_mobile_phone_no, :global.intl_fax_no,
 :global.intl_addr2, :global.intl_addr3
 from addresses
 where address_id = t_addr_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :global.intl_country := null;
 :global.intl_postal_code := null;
 :global.intl_home_phone_no := null;
 :global.intl_work_phone_no := null;
 :global.intl_work_phone_ext := null;
 :global.intl_mobile_phone_no := null;
 :global.intl_fax_no := null;
 :global.intl_addr2 := null;
 :global.intl_addr3 := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 enable_disable_address('D');
 set_item_property('addresses.pb_intl_addr', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 else
 enable_disable_address('E');
 set_item_property('addresses.pb_intl_addr', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if; --if nvl(:global.intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y' then
 -- End of change
 ELSE
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2011 for changes relating to adding international address columns
 enable_disable_address('E');
 set_item_property('addresses.pb_intl_addr', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- End of change
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE time_format_function( input_str in varchar2,
 output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

 string_length := NVL( length( input_str), 0) ;

 if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr( input_str, 3, 1) = ':' then
 if to_number( substr( input_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( input_str, 4, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 elsif string_length = 4 then
 if to_number( substr( output_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( output_str, 4, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 output_str := substr( input_str, 1, 2) || ':' || 
 substr( input_str, 3, 2) ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
END;
